//: Studio entry (src/studio) only; owned by the Studio module. Vendored lila code is never type-checked (PLAN §1):
src/studio imports it as `lila/<package>/<module>` (e.g. `lila/analyse/start`, `lila/site/asset`). Here `paths` maps
that to a hand-written declaration, src/studio/lila-types/<package>/<module>.d.ts, so tsc never opens a vendored .ts file;
Vite (vite.config.ts) maps the same specifier to web/vendor/lila/<package>/src/<module>. Declare only what Studio uses.
lila's ambient types (vendor/lila/@types/lichess: declaration files only, skipped by skipLibCheck) are included for
`site`, `i18n`, `$html` and friends. Never import web/vendor/lila by relative path: `npm run typecheck` fails if any
vendored source file enters this program (typecheck:studio-boundary in web/package.json).
